correctness.rationale: Exact conditional Poisson no-event laws give the Youden objective. Strict objective monotonicity puts the maximizer on the efficient lower convex chain; its strictly concave log has one maximizer. Segment derivatives and endpoint one-sided derivatives prove all quantified formulas, including the nonempty vertex intervals. The exact rational three-point configuration has slopes 3/10 and 3/4 and all five phases. The supplementary checker passes 9409 direct comparisons; infinite quantification is proved analytically, not inferred from tests.

value.rationale: For calibrated modalities the result gives all budget-optimal choices, a hard two-active-mode support cap, sequential reallocation toward lower false rates with growing budget, and obligatory intermediate pure and mixed phases. This addresses the practical mismatch between sensitivity and false alarms in ecological acoustics while clearly limiting itself to an idealized one-bit decision rule.
